data.title: Marina Views
data.about:
Marina Views is a landmark development offering a sophisticated lifestyle in the heart of Rashid Yachts & Marina, Port Rashid, Bur Dubai. This prestigious multi-building complex, developed by Emaar Properties through its subsidiary Mina Rashid Properties, comprises Marina Views Building 1, Marina Views Building 2, and Marina Views Building 3. The apartments are available in 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom configuration.

Located just moments away from Downtown Dubai, Marina Views apartments for sale boasts a prime position in one of the city's most iconic areas. As a project by Emaar, a prominent name in Dubai’s real estate, Marina Views promises unmatched quality and elegance, making it a coveted address for discerning residents.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Enjoy panoramic waterfront views from the comfort of your home.
  • Marina Views offers direct access to the marina.
  • Marina Views residential project is just moments away from from exquisite dining, retail, shopping, and leisure spots.
  • It is a project of Emaar, a prominent name in Dubai’s real estate.
  • The complex is located in one of Dubai's most iconic areas.
  • Features a landscaped amenity platform with a variety of world-class facilities. 
  • Located next to the community park and Dubai’s longest-swimmable canal pool.

location_tile.title: Located Moments Away From the Ocean!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Rashid Yachts & Marina is a premier waterfront destination located in the historic Port Rashid, Bur Dubai. This prestigious marina is renowned for its luxurious yachts, stunning views, and world-class amenities. 

Positioned along Dubai's expansive coastline, Rashid Yachts & Marina offers a serene and picturesque environment, making it a sought-after location for both residents and visitors. The marina is designed to cater to the elite yachting community, providing state-of-the-art berthing facilities, elegant waterfront dining, and a host of recreational activities, all within a secure and exclusive setting.

15 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
15 Minutes to Dubai Creek Harbour
20 Minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB)
20 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates
25 Minutes to Dubai Marina
